bernie.game.start.1.text: Alright, hons, cards are up! Who wants coffee?

bernie.game.start.2.text: Ooh, I love a card game. My cousin Darlene once played Hearts for three days straight.

bernie.game.start.3.text: Okay sugar, deal 'em out. I'm on my break.

bernie.game.won.human.1.text: Look at you, hon! Big winner! That deserves a slice of pie.

bernie.game.won.human.2.text: Well, aren't you something! Nicely done, sugar.

bernie.game.won.other.1.text: Good game, hon! You earned it.

bernie.game.won.self.2.text: I won! Wait'll I tell Darlene. She's gonna be so jealous.

bernie.gin.dead_hand.1.text: Nobody wins, hon. Like a slow Tuesday.

bernie.gin.dead_hand.2.text: A dead hand. Let's call it a coffee break.

bernie.gin.gin.human.1.text: Gin! Look at you, sugar! Pie's on the house.

bernie.gin.gin.self.2.text: Gin! My cousin Darlene would be so proud. Or jealous.

bernie.gin.knock.human.1.text: Knockin' already, hon? Let's see the check.

bernie.gin.knock.human.2.text: Ooh, a knock. Let's see what you cooked up.

bernie.gin.knock.self.1.text: I'm knockin', hon. Like the health inspector.

bernie.gin.took_discard.human.1.text: Oh, you wanted that one? It's all yours, sugar.

bernie.gin.took_discard.human.2.text: Takin' my leftovers, hon? There's plenty.

bernie.gin.undercut.human.1.text: Undercut! You got me good, sugar.

bernie.gin.undercut.human.2.text: Oof. Sent back to the kitchen.

bernie.gin.undercut.self.2.text: Ha! Darlene taught me that one. She cheats, but still.

bernie.hand.bad.human.1.text: Aw, sugar. Happens to the best of us. Happens to Darlene a lot.

bernie.hand.bad.self.1.text: Oof. That hand was like a Monday double shift.

bernie.hand.bad.self.2.text: Well, that went over like a cold cup of coffee.

bernie.hand.good.human.1.text: Ooh, look at you go, hon!

bernie.hand.good.self.1.text: Ha! Order up! One winning hand!

bernie.hand.good.self.2.text: Now that's what I call a good shift.

bernie.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are open, hons! Kitchen's hot!

bernie.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: Oops! Broke the hearts. Like Darlene's third husband.

bernie.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Nice one, sugar! Ten points off the bill!

bernie.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! Now that's a good tip!

bernie.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Sorry, hon! Can't let you have the whole pie!

bernie.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Aw, sugar, you almost had it!

bernie.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Oh, so close! That's like dropping the last plate on the tray.

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: You shot the moon?! Well, I'll be! Pie for you, on the house!

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: Well, I'll be darned. Good for you, hon.

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I shot the moon! Somebody call Darlene!

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six for everybody! Sorry, hons, kitchen's closed!

bernie.hearts.pass.received.2.text: Ooh, what did you send me? Oh. Oh, sugar, no.

bernie.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: Here ya go, hon! Compliments of the house!

bernie.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: Special of the day: one Queen of Spades. Enjoy!

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Oh, hon. I'm so sorry. Want a muffin?

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.human.2.text: Ooh, that's a rough one, sugar.

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Oh honey, nobody wants her. Nobody!

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Oh, for crying out loud. Thirteen points! That's like a whole table of bad tippers.

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: Well, that's just my luck. Darlene would laugh so hard.

bernie.idle.human.1.text: Take your time, hon. Darlene once took twenty minutes to pick a card.

bernie.idle.human.2.text: No rush, sugar. Want me to top off your coffee?

bernie.poker.bad_beat.human.1.text: Aw, hon, that's just rotten luck.

bernie.poker.bad_beat.human.2.text: Oh, sugar. That hurts. Want some coffee?

bernie.poker.bad_beat.self.1.text: Oh, come ON! That was a good hand, hon!

bernie.poker.bad_beat.self.2.text: That's like dropping a whole tray of pies.

bernie.poker.big_hand.human.2.text: Sugar, that's a hand to tell Darlene about!

bernie.poker.big_hand.self.1.text: Full house, hon! Like the diner on a Sunday!

bernie.poker.big_hand.self.2.text: Look at this beauty! I'm framing it by the register!

bernie.poker.big_pot.human.1.text: Hon, that's a big pot! Treat yourself to pie!

bernie.poker.big_pot.human.2.text: Whoa, sugar! That's a lot of chips!

bernie.poker.big_pot.self.1.text: Ooh! That's more than a week of tips!

bernie.poker.big_pot.self.2.text: Big pot for Bernie! Darlene's gonna be so jealous!

bernie.poker.bluff.self.1.text: I had nothing, hon! Not even a pair of salt shakers.

bernie.poker.bluff.self.2.text: Bluffed! Darlene taught me that one. Don't tell her.

bernie.poker.busted.human.1.text: Aw, hon. Go win some at Rummy and come back.

bernie.poker.busted.human.2.text: Out of chips, sugar? Pie's on me.

bernie.poker.busted.self.1.text: Well, I'm tapped out, hon. Back to the diner.

bernie.poker.busted.self.2.text: No more chips. Guess I'm working a double.

bernie.poker.fold.self.1.text: I'm out, hon. This hand's colder than the walk-in.

bernie.poker.fold.self.2.text: Fold. I'll go refill everybody's coffee.

bernie.poker.raise.human.2.text: A raise, sugar? Well, bring it on!

bernie.poker.raise.self.1.text: I'll raise, hon. Live a little!

bernie.poker.raise.self.2.text: Raise! Like the price of coffee.

bernie.poker.sit_down.self.1.text: Mind if I sit, hon? I'm on my break.

bernie.poker.stood_pat.human.2.text: Standing pat, hon? You're making me nervous.

bernie.poker.stood_pat.self.1.text: I'll keep these, hon. They're cozy.

bernie.poker.stood_pat.self.2.text: No cards for me, sugar. I'm good.

bernie.poker.won_pot.human.1.text: Nice one, hon! You earned that!

bernie.poker.won_pot.human.2.text: Look at you, sugar! Raking it in!

bernie.poker.won_pot.other.2.text: Enjoy it, sugar. I'll get the next one.

bernie.poker.won_pot.self.1.text: Ooh, that's my tip jar filling up, hon!

bernie.poker.won_pot.self.2.text: Order up! One pot for Bernie!

bernie.poker.won_pot.self.3.text: Well, would you look at that! Mine, sugar!

bernie.rummy.big_meld.human.1.text: Ooh, look at that meld, sugar!

bernie.rummy.big_meld.human.2.text: Now that's a full order, hon!

bernie.rummy.big_meld.self.1.text: Look at that, hon! Blue plate special!

bernie.rummy.big_meld.self.2.text: That's a big one! Like Darlene's hair in '88.

bernie.rummy.caught.human.1.text: Oof, caught with a full hand, sugar.

bernie.rummy.caught.human.2.text: That's a heavy tray, hon. Happens to everybody.

bernie.rummy.caught.self.1.text: Caught with a full tray, hon. Story of my life.

bernie.rummy.caught.self.2.text: All these cards! I'm holdin' more than the lunch rush.

bernie.rummy.layoff.human.1.text: Sure, hon, add it to my meld. Make yourself at home.

bernie.rummy.layoff.human.2.text: Puttin' your card on my meld? That's family-style.

bernie.rummy.took_pile.human.1.text: The whole pile, hon? Somebody's hungry!

bernie.rummy.took_pile.human.2.text: Takin' it all! Darlene does that at buffets.

bernie.rummy.took_pile.self.1.text: I'll take the whole pile, hon. Family size.

bernie.rummy.took_pile.self.2.text: Gimme all of it. I've carried twelve plates at once.

bernie.rummy.went_out.human.1.text: You're out already, hon? I barely wiped the counter.

bernie.rummy.went_out.human.2.text: Look at you, out already! Somebody get this one a pie.

bernie.spades.bags.them.1.text: Ooh, too many bags, sugar. That'll cost ya.

bernie.spades.bags.us.1.text: Too many bags! I'm a waitress, not a grocery store!

bernie.spades.bags.us.2.text: A bag penalty. Darlene does that every game.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Ooh, brave! Don't worry, sugar, I've got you.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: Okay hon, you sit pretty. I'll take the tricks.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil for me, hon. I'm on my break.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: Goin' nil! Darlene says I can't do it. Watch me.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Ooh, there goes your nil, hon! Sorry! Not sorry!

bernie.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: Nil's broken! Sending that one back to the kitchen.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Aw, sugar. Don't you worry about it.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Happens to the best of us, hon. Happens to Darlene weekly.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Oops! Took a trick. Like dropping a full tray.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: There goes my nil. Darlene's gonna laugh.

bernie.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Well, good for you, hon. Credit where it's due.

bernie.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: You did it, hon! Pie's on me!

bernie.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: Look at you, sugar! A perfect nil!

bernie.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not one trick! Wait'll I tell Darlene!

bernie.spades.set.them.1.text: You got set, hon! Want some pie to feel better?

bernie.spades.set.us.1.text: We got set, hon. Like a Monday double shift.

bernie.spades.set.us.2.text: Oof. That went over like cold coffee.

bernie.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: That's my partner! Big tip for you!

chad.game.start.3.text: Big energy today, people. BIG energy.

chad.game.won.human.1.text: Respect! That was an elite performance. I'm taking notes.

chad.game.won.human.2.text: You crushed it! Up top! ...Okay, virtual up top.

chad.game.won.other.1.text: Tough loss. Great learning opportunity, though!

chad.game.won.other.2.text: Second place is just first place with extra motivation.

chad.game.won.self.1.text: CHAMPION MINDSET! Did everyone see that?

chad.game.won.self.2.text: That's what happens when you trust the process!

chad.game.won.self.3.text: I'd like to thank my smoothie.

chad.gin.dead_hand.1.text: A dead hand. A tie. Basically a win for both of us!

chad.gin.dead_hand.2.text: Nobody won. That's just a rest day, people.

chad.gin.gin.human.1.text: Gin?! Okay. Respect. Huge respect. I'm fine.

chad.gin.gin.human.2.text: Wow. Gin. You're coaching ME now.

chad.gin.gin.self.1.text: GIN! And the crowd goes WILD!

chad.gin.knock.human.1.text: Bold move! I love the energy!

chad.gin.knock.human.2.text: A knock! Let's see the tape on this one.

chad.gin.took_discard.human.1.text: You want my discard? Smart! I taught you that!

chad.gin.took_discard.human.2.text: Taking my card! That's called scouting the competition!

chad.gin.undercut.human.1.text: Undercut. That's fine. That's a learning moment.

chad.gin.undercut.human.2.text: Ooh, the knock backfired. Nobody saw that coming. Especially me.

chad.gin.undercut.self.2.text: Undercut! That's what we call a reversal, folks!

chad.hand.bad.human.1.text: Shake it off! Next hand is a fresh rep!

chad.hand.bad.self.1.text: That's fine. That's fine. Pain is just progress in disguise.

chad.hand.bad.self.2.text: I'm not losing, I'm building a comeback story.

chad.hand.bad.self.3.text: Totally part of my strategy. Which I'll explain later.

chad.hand.good.human.1.text: Okay, okay! You're bringing the heat!

chad.hand.good.self.2.text: Textbook. I should teach a seminar.

chad.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are open! Let's get cardio!

chad.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: I broke the hearts! Like I break personal records!

chad.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Nice grab! Great hands, great hands.

chad.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! That's what a winner looks like!

chad.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Ahh, so close! Still elite effort, though.

chad.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: So close! I'm counting that as a moral victory.

chad.hearts.moon_blocked.self.2.text: That's okay! I'll shoot for the moon again next hand. And the next.

chad.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: No way! That's legendary! Can I put you in my podcast?

chad.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: You shot the MOON! That's straight-up elite!

chad.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: MOON SHOT! I told you! I TOLD everyone!

chad.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Shoot for the moon! Even if you miss... wait, I didn't miss!

chad.hearts.pass.received.1.text: Great cards! I mean, terrible cards. Great attitude though!

chad.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: And Brightwater dumps the Queen! The crowd goes wild!

chad.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Brutal! Gotta respect the grind, though.

chad.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Thirteen points? That's just a really heavy rep.

chad.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: Okay, taking the Queen was a power move. I meant to do that.

chad.idle.human.1.text: No pressure! But also, what's taking so long, buddy?

chad.idle.human.2.text: Deep breaths. Visualize the card. Become the card.

chad.poker.bad_beat.human.1.text: Brutal! But you'll bounce back, I know it!

chad.poker.bad_beat.human.2.text: Ouch! Shake it off. Next hand is yours.

chad.poker.bad_beat.self.2.text: Three of a kind and I lose? I'm putting this in my book.

chad.poker.big_hand.human.1.text: Whoa! That's a highlight reel hand!

chad.poker.big_hand.self.1.text: Full house! Chad delivers in the clutch!

chad.poker.big_hand.self.2.text: Look at this hand! Frame it! Put it in a museum!

chad.poker.big_pot.human.2.text: Huge pot! You're in the zone right now!

chad.poker.big_pot.self.1.text: Monster pot! This is what peak performance looks like!

chad.poker.big_pot.self.2.text: Chad with the BIG win! The crowd is on its feet!

chad.poker.bluff.self.2.text: Total bluff. Believe in yourself and nobody calls.

chad.poker.busted.human.1.text: Hey, every great comeback starts at zero!

chad.poker.busted.human.2.text: Out of chips? This is your origin story!

chad.poker.busted.self.1.text: I'm out! But champions always rebuy. Eventually.

chad.poker.busted.self.2.text: Zero chips. Maximum lessons. Thanks, everyone!

chad.poker.fold.self.2.text: Folding. Even champions take a knee.

chad.poker.raise.human.2.text: You're raising? Love it! Let's go!

chad.poker.raise.self.1.text: Raise! Go big or go home!

chad.poker.raise.self.2.text: I'm raising! Fortune favors the bold!

chad.poker.sit_down.self.1.text: Coach is in the house! Let's get it!

chad.poker.sit_down.self.2.text: Chad here! Ready to crush it! Respectfully!

chad.poker.stood_pat.human.1.text: No draw? Bold strategy! Love the energy!

chad.poker.stood_pat.human.2.text: Standing pat? Okay, I respect the confidence.

chad.poker.stood_pat.self.1.text: No cards needed. I'm already elite.

chad.poker.won_pot.human.1.text: Great execution! I see you. I SEE you.

chad.poker.won_pot.human.2.text: You took it down! Respect. Huge respect.

chad.poker.won_pot.other.2.text: Nice hand. I'm just warming up.

chad.poker.won_pot.self.1.text: And Chad takes the pot! What a play!

chad.poker.won_pot.self.2.text: That's called a winning mindset, people!

chad.rummy.big_meld.human.1.text: Big meld! Big energy! I respect it!

chad.rummy.big_meld.human.2.text: Whoa! That's a highlight right there!

chad.rummy.big_meld.self.1.text: Look at that meld! Highlight reel!

chad.rummy.caught.human.1.text: Caught with cards! Happens to the best. Mostly to me.

chad.rummy.caught.human.2.text: Tough break! Shake it off, champ!

chad.rummy.caught.self.1.text: Caught holding cards. Totally part of the plan.

chad.rummy.caught.self.2.text: All these points in my hand. That's just potential energy.

chad.rummy.layoff.human.1.text: Using my meld? Teamwork! Kind of!

chad.rummy.layoff.human.2.text: Hey, that's my play! ...Great assist though.

chad.rummy.took_pile.human.1.text: The whole pile? Now THAT is commitment!

chad.rummy.took_pile.human.2.text: Taking everything! I love the ambition!

chad.rummy.took_pile.self.1.text: I'm taking the WHOLE pile! Go big or go home!

chad.rummy.went_out.human.1.text: You're out?! I wasn't done strategizing!

chad.rummy.went_out.human.2.text: Wow, out already. I'm calling a timeout. Retroactively.

chad.rummy.went_out.self.1.text: I'm OUT! Touchdown! Spike the cards!

chad.spades.bags.them.1.text: Bag penalty! Gotta respect the fundamentals!

chad.spades.bags.us.1.text: Bag penalty?! Nobody told me bags were bad!

chad.spades.bags.us.2.text: Too many bags. I over-performed. Classic Chad.

chad.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil?! Bold move! I've got your back, teammate!

chad.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: You go nil, I go beast mode. Team synergy!

chad.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Going NIL! Zero tricks, maximum confidence!

chad.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: Nil! This is my comeback story, people!

chad.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: And the nil goes DOWN! What a play!

chad.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: The crowd goes wild! The nil is broken!

chad.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Shake it off, teammate! Fresh rep next hand!

chad.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Hey, failure is just data! Mostly bad data.

chad.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Okay, that trick was a learning opportunity.

chad.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: Nil's gone. But my spirit? Undefeated.

chad.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Respect. That was a clean nil. I'm taking notes.

chad.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: NIL MADE! Up top, partner! ...Virtual up top!

chad.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: That's what I call executing the game plan!

chad.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: Perfect nil! I'd like to thank my smoothie.

chad.spades.set.them.1.text: SET! That's a defensive masterclass, folks!

chad.spades.set.us.1.text: We got set. That's fine. That's FINE.

chad.spades.set.us.2.text: Not a loss. A setback. A set... back.

chad.spades.trumped.self.2.text: Trumped it! And the crowd goes wild!

dot.game.start.1.text: Oh, how lovely! I do enjoy a friendly game.

dot.game.start.2.text: Let me just put my knitting down. There. Now, let's play nicely.

dot.game.start.3.text: I brought lemon bars for after. Winners get two.

dot.game.won.human.1.text: Well done, sweetheart! You earned a lemon bar.

dot.game.won.human.2.text: Oh, you clever thing. I'll remember this.

dot.game.won.human.3.text: Wonderful! You've been practicing, haven't you?

dot.game.won.other.1.text: Good for you, dear. Enjoy it.

dot.game.won.self.1.text: Oh my goodness, did I win? How did that happen? I'm sorry, dears.

dot.game.won.self.2.text: Well, isn't that nice. Same time next week?

dot.gin.dead_hand.1.text: Nobody won? Well, more time for tea.

dot.gin.dead_hand.2.text: A draw. How very polite of us both.

dot.gin.gin.human.1.text: Gin! Good for you, sweetheart. Grandma's watching now.

dot.gin.gin.human.2.text: Oh my. Well done, dear. Have a lemon bar.

dot.gin.gin.self.1.text: Gin! Oh, isn't that nice? For me, I mean.

dot.gin.gin.self.2.text: All tidy, like a basket of yarn. Gin, dear.

dot.gin.knock.human.1.text: Oh! Knocking already? Let's have a look.

dot.gin.knock.self.1.text: I think I'll knock now, dear. Just a little tap.

dot.gin.knock.self.2.text: Knock knock! Don't worry, it won't hurt. Much.

dot.gin.took_discard.human.1.text: Oh, you wanted that? You only had to ask, dear.

dot.gin.took_discard.human.2.text: Picking up Grandma's leftovers? Help yourself.

dot.gin.undercut.human.1.text: Undercut! Well, aren't you clever. I'll remember that.

dot.gin.undercut.human.2.text: Oh my. You got me fair and square. This time.

dot.gin.undercut.self.1.text: Oh dear, I undercut you. Was that rude? It felt lovely.

dot.gin.undercut.self.2.text: Grandma had a few low cards tucked away. Undercut!

dot.hand.bad.human.2.text: Don't you worry, sweetie. There's always next hand.

dot.hand.bad.self.1.text: Oh dear. Well, it's only a game. For now.

dot.hand.bad.self.2.text: Hmm. Grandma's going to have to pay closer attention.

dot.hand.good.human.1.text: Look at you go! Very nicely played, dear.

dot.hand.good.self.1.text: Oh, look at that. Beginner's luck, I suppose. For the sixtieth year.

dot.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Oh, did I break the hearts? I'm such a klutz.

dot.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: Hearts are open, dears. Mind your fingers.

dot.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: Oh, the Jack! He's always been my favorite.

dot.hearts.jack_taken.self.2.text: Minus ten for Grandma. Isn't that sweet?

dot.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Sorry, dear. Grandma had to stop you. It's for your own good.

dot.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Oh, so close, sweetie! Next time.

dot.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Oh, phooey. Grandma was so close.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: My goodness! You shot the moon! I'm so proud. And a little annoyed.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: Oh my. Well, isn't that impressive.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: Oh! I seem to have shot the moon. Whoopsie.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six for everyone else! Don't be cross with Grandma.

dot.hearts.pass.received.1.text: Oh, how thoughtful of you, dear. Truly.

dot.hearts.pass.received.2.text: What lovely cards. I'll put them to good use.

dot.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: Here you are, dear. A little gift from Grandma.

dot.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: Oh, I didn't have anything else. Honestly. Mostly.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Oh, I'm so sorry, sweetheart. Not really, but I'm sorry.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.human.2.text: Oops! Was that me? Silly old Dot.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Thirteen points. Have a lemon bar.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.other.2.text: Somebody had to take her, dear.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Oh, the Queen! Well, we're both old ladies, I suppose.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: Hmm. I'll remember who did that, dear.

dot.idle.human.1.text: Take your time, dear. I'll just finish this row.

dot.idle.human.2.text: No rush, sweetheart. I've got a scarf to finish.

dot.poker.bad_beat.human.1.text: Oh, sweetheart, that was so unlucky.

dot.poker.bad_beat.human.2.text: Poor dear. Have a lemon bar. It helps.

dot.poker.bad_beat.self.1.text: Oh dear. That was a very good hand, too.

dot.poker.bad_beat.self.2.text: Well. I'll remember that, dear. I always do.

dot.poker.big_hand.human.1.text: My goodness, what a hand! I'm impressed.

dot.poker.big_hand.human.2.text: Oh, you've been practicing. I can tell.

dot.poker.big_hand.self.1.text: A full house! Just like Thanksgiving.

dot.poker.big_hand.self.2.text: Oh look, dear. Isn't that a pretty hand?

dot.poker.big_pot.human.1.text: Goodness! Look at all those chips, dear.

dot.poker.big_pot.human.2.text: That's a big pile, sweetheart. Don't lose it to me.

dot.poker.big_pot.self.1.text: Oh my, that's a lot of yarn money.

dot.poker.big_pot.self.2.text: My, my. Grandma's having a very good day.

dot.poker.bluff.self.1.text: Oh, I had nothing at all. Isn't that funny?

dot.poker.bluff.self.2.text: Don't tell anyone, dear. Grandma was fibbing.

dot.poker.busted.human.1.text: Oh, sweetheart. Don't worry, you'll win it back.

dot.poker.busted.human.2.text: All out? Come have a lemon bar and try again later.

dot.poker.busted.self.1.text: Oh dear, I'm all out. Back to my knitting.

dot.poker.busted.self.2.text: Well, that's my chips gone. I'll be back, dear.

dot.poker.fold.self.1.text: I'll sit this one out and knit a row.

dot.poker.fold.self.2.text: Not this time, dear. I'm patient.

dot.poker.raise.human.1.text: A raise! Oh, you naughty thing.

dot.poker.raise.human.2.text: Raising your sweet old grandma? Well, all right.

dot.poker.raise.self.1.text: I believe I'll raise, dear. Just a little.

dot.poker.raise.self.2.text: Let's make it interesting, shall we?

dot.poker.sit_down.self.1.text: Mind if Grandma joins you, dears?

dot.poker.sit_down.self.2.text: Hello, dears. I brought my lucky cardigan.

dot.poker.stood_pat.human.1.text: None at all? Aren't you confident, dear.

dot.poker.stood_pat.human.2.text: Oh, standing pat? How brave. Or is it?

dot.poker.stood_pat.self.1.text: I'm quite happy with these, thank you.

dot.poker.stood_pat.self.2.text: No cards for me, dear. I'm all set.

dot.poker.won_pot.human.1.text: Well done, sweetheart. Enjoy it while it lasts.

dot.poker.won_pot.human.2.text: Good for you, dear. I'm keeping an eye on you.

dot.poker.won_pot.other.1.text: Oh, good for you. I'll get it back, of course.

dot.poker.won_pot.other.2.text: Lovely. Do enjoy those chips while you have them.

dot.poker.won_pot.self.1.text: Oh, how lovely. I'll just tuck these away.

dot.poker.won_pot.self.2.text: Thank you, dears. Grandma's knitting fund thanks you.

dot.poker.won_pot.self.3.text: Oh my, was that mine? How nice.

dot.rummy.big_meld.human.1.text: Oh, that's a lovely meld, dear.

dot.rummy.big_meld.human.2.text: My goodness, look at all those. Very nice.

dot.rummy.big_meld.self.1.text: Look at that. Neat as a sweater.

dot.rummy.big_meld.self.2.text: A lovely big meld. I knit it myself.

dot.rummy.caught.human.1.text: Oh, sweetheart, that's a lot of cards to be holding.

dot.rummy.caught.human.2.text: Caught with your hands full. It happens to the best of us.

dot.rummy.caught.self.1.text: Oh dear. I was holding onto those for a reason.

dot.rummy.caught.self.2.text: Caught with all these cards. How embarrassing.

dot.rummy.layoff.human.1.text: Oh, adding to Grandma's meld? How thoughtful.

dot.rummy.layoff.human.2.text: You're welcome to my cards, dear. This once.

dot.rummy.took_pile.human.1.text: My, that's quite a handful, dear.

dot.rummy.took_pile.human.2.text: Taking the whole pile? Very bold. I approve.

dot.rummy.took_pile.self.1.text: I'll just take all of these, if nobody minds.

dot.rummy.took_pile.self.2.text: The whole pile? Oh, why not. Grandma likes a project.

dot.rummy.went_out.human.2.text: Oh, well played, dear. Grandma wasn't quite ready.

dot.rummy.went_out.self.1.text: I'm all out, dear. Like my good yarn.

dot.rummy.went_out.self.2.text: Out! Sorry, sweetheart. Not very sorry.

dot.spades.bags.them.1.text: All those bags, dear. Tsk, tsk.

dot.spades.bags.us.1.text: Too many bags. I really must tidy up.

dot.spades.bags.us.2.text: Oh, a hundred points for bags. That's my own fault.

dot.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Don't you worry, sweetie. Grandma's got you.

dot.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: Oh, how brave! I'll take the tricks, dear. You just relax.

dot.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil for me, dears. I'll just sit quietly and knit.

dot.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I'll bid nothing at all. Grandma's being modest.

dot.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Oh, what a shame, dear. Was that my card? How awful.

dot.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: There goes your nil. Bless your heart.

dot.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Oh, sweetie. It happens to the best of us.

dot.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Never mind, dear. We'll knit it back together.

dot.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Oh, fiddlesticks. There goes my nil.

dot.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Well done, dear. I'll get you next time. Sweetly.

dot.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: You did it, sweetheart! I'm so proud of you.

dot.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: A perfect nil! You get two lemon bars.

dot.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not one trick! Sixty years of practice, dears.

dot.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: Oh my, a perfect nil. Lemon bars all around.

dot.spades.set.them.1.text: Oh no, you didn't make it? Well, next time, dear.

dot.spades.set.them.2.text: Set! Such a pity. More tea, anyone?

dot.spades.set.us.1.text: Oh dear. We came up a little short.

dot.spades.set.us.2.text: Hmm. Grandma will have to pay closer attention.

dot.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: Ooh, nicely done. You're a natural.

dot.spades.trumped.self.1.text: Oh, was that a spade? Silly me.

dot.spades.trumped.self.2.text: A little spade for Grandma. Thank you, dears.

gus.game.start.1.text: Fine. Deal 'em. I already know they're bad.

gus.game.start.2.text: Thirty-one years of carrying mail and this is my retirement. Cards.

gus.game.start.3.text: Let's get this over with. My coffee's getting cold.

gus.game.won.human.1.text: Beginner's luck. For the hundredth time.

gus.game.won.human.2.text: Congratulations. Have a peppermint. Don't tell anyone I'm nice.

gus.game.won.human.3.text: You won fair and square. I'm still going to complain about it.

gus.game.won.other.1.text: Of course. Of course they won.

gus.game.won.other.2.text: Everybody wins but Gus. Story of my life.

gus.game.won.self.1.text: Well, what do you know. The universe owes me one less.

gus.game.won.self.2.text: I won? Somebody write that down. With a date.

gus.game.won.self.3.text: Don't get used to this. I'm not.

gus.gin.dead_hand.1.text: Nobody wins. Feels like most Tuesdays.

gus.gin.dead_hand.2.text: A dead hand. Deliver it to the dead letter office.

gus.gin.gin.human.1.text: Gin? Of course it is. The deck's rigged.

gus.gin.gin.human.2.text: Gin. I'm going to need a peppermint for this one.

gus.gin.gin.self.1.text: Gin. Don't make a fuss. Okay, a small fuss.

gus.gin.gin.self.2.text: Gin! Every card delivered to the right address.

gus.gin.knock.human.1.text: Knocking already? I just sat down.

gus.gin.knock.human.2.text: Alright, alright. Let's see what you've got.

gus.gin.knock.self.2.text: I'm knocking. Brace yourself. Or don't. I'm not your boss.

gus.gin.took_discard.human.1.text: Hey, I threw that away on purpose.

gus.gin.took_discard.human.2.text: Taking my junk mail? Be my guest.

gus.gin.undercut.human.1.text: Undercut. By you. I need to sit down. I am sitting down.

gus.gin.undercut.human.2.text: Well, that backfired. Like my old mail truck.

gus.gin.undercut.self.1.text: Undercut! Return to sender, postage due.

gus.gin.undercut.self.2.text: Thought you had me. Nobody has Gus. Except that goose.

gus.hand.bad.human.1.text: Join the club. We have jackets.

gus.hand.bad.self.1.text: Rigged. I'm telling you, the deck's rigged.

gus.hand.bad.self.2.text: I've had better hands delivering junk mail.

gus.hand.bad.self.3.text: That hand was worse than the goose on Elm Street.

gus.hand.good.human.1.text: You're making me look bad. Not that I needed the help.

gus.hand.good.human.2.text: Smooth. Real smooth. I hate it.

gus.hand.good.self.1.text: Huh. That almost felt like luck.

gus.hand.good.self.2.text: Don't look so surprised. I'm surprised enough for all of us.

gus.hearts.hearts_broken.other.1.text: And there go the hearts. Here comes the trouble.

gus.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: There. I broke 'em. Somebody had to.

gus.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: Hearts are open. Like my heart. Which is closed.

gus.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! Finally, a card that likes me.

gus.hearts.jack_taken.self.2.text: Minus ten. Don't tell anyone I smiled.

gus.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Not on my watch. Gus delivers. Gus also blocks.

gus.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Ooh, so close. Welcome to my whole life.

gus.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: One card. ONE card. I was this close.

gus.hearts.moon_blocked.self.2.text: Foiled again. Story of my life.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: You shot the moon? I need to sit down. I am sitting down. I need to sit down more.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: Unbelievable. Truly. I'm calling the post office.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: Someone shot the moon and it wasn't me. Shocking. Not.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I shot the moon. Don't make a fuss. Okay, make a small fuss.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six for everybody! Merry Christmas from Gus.

gus.hearts.pass.received.2.text: You passed me these? On purpose?

gus.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: Thirty-one years of practice getting rid of things nobody wants.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Ooh. Return to sender, I'm afraid.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Better you than me. Much better.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Thirteen points. Just like my blood pressure. Times ten.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: The Queen and I go way back. She never liked me.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.self.3.text: Oh good. More mail I didn't ask for.

gus.idle.human.1.text: Take your time. I've only got maybe twenty good years left.

gus.idle.human.2.text: I delivered mail faster than this. Uphill. In the snow.

gus.poker.bad_beat.human.1.text: Ooh. That's a rough one. Even I feel bad.

gus.poker.bad_beat.human.2.text: That's the deck for you. Crooked as a country road.

gus.poker.bad_beat.self.1.text: Three of a kind, and it loses. This deck is RIGGED.

gus.poker.bad_beat.self.2.text: I'm writing a strongly worded letter about that.

gus.poker.big_hand.human.1.text: Where were you hiding that? Under the doormat?

gus.poker.big_hand.human.2.text: Well, that's a hand. Don't rub it in.

gus.poker.big_hand.self.1.text: Full house. Finally, a delivery worth making.

gus.poker.big_hand.self.2.text: Now that's what I call first class mail.

gus.poker.big_pot.human.1.text: That's a whole lot of my coins going home with you.

gus.poker.big_pot.human.2.text: Take it easy. That pot had my goose's birdseed money in it.

gus.poker.big_pot.self.2.text: Thirty years of junk mail, and finally a real package.

gus.poker.bluff.self.1.text: Had nothing. Don't tell anyone. Especially the goose.

gus.poker.bluff.self.2.text: Return to sender. Contents: absolutely nothing.

gus.poker.busted.human.1.text: Out already? Happens to the best of us. Mostly me.

gus.poker.busted.human.2.text: Rough night. Go win some coins at Hearts and come back.

gus.poker.busted.self.1.text: That's it. I'm broke. The goose eats bread crusts tonight.

gus.poker.busted.self.2.text: Out of chips. Rigged, every last card.

gus.poker.fold.self.1.text: Fold. This hand belongs in the dead letter office.

gus.poker.fold.self.2.text: I'm out. Rigged, I tell you.

gus.poker.raise.human.1.text: A raise? Bold. Suspicious, but bold.

gus.poker.raise.human.2.text: Raising on me? I've been bitten by smaller dogs.

gus.poker.raise.self.2.text: I'll raise. Somebody has to keep you honest.

gus.poker.sit_down.self.1.text: Move over. Grumbles is here, and he's not happy about it.

gus.poker.sit_down.self.2.text: I'm sitting in. Don't get any ideas.

gus.poker.stood_pat.human.1.text: No cards? Now I'm nervous. And I'm never nervous.

gus.poker.stood_pat.human.2.text: Standing pat. Either you've got it, or you've got nerve.

gus.poker.stood_pat.self.2.text: No cards for me. Package is complete.

gus.poker.won_pot.human.1.text: Fine. Take it. Don't spend it all on one goose.

gus.poker.won_pot.human.2.text: Hmph. Your mail always arrives on time, doesn't it?

gus.poker.won_pot.other.1.text: Of course. The deck picks favorites.

gus.poker.won_pot.other.2.text: Congratulations. I'll be over here, being robbed.

gus.poker.won_pot.self.1.text: Delivered. Signed, sealed, and in my pile.

gus.poker.won_pot.self.2.text: Huh. The rigged deck slipped up and helped me.

gus.poker.won_pot.self.3.text: Don't look so shocked. Even I win sometimes.

gus.rummy.big_meld.human.2.text: That's a lot of cards. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone.

gus.rummy.big_meld.self.1.text: Look at that. Organized. Like a mail sorter.

gus.rummy.big_meld.self.2.text: A big one. Don't tell anyone I smiled.

gus.rummy.caught.human.1.text: Caught with a full hand. Welcome to my world.

gus.rummy.caught.human.2.text: Ooh, that's a heavy bag to carry. Trust me, I know.

gus.rummy.caught.self.2.text: All these points, stuck in my hand. Like my pension.

gus.rummy.layoff.human.1.text: Sure, use my meld. Everybody does.

gus.rummy.took_pile.human.1.text: Taking the whole pile? Hope your arms are strong.

gus.rummy.took_pile.human.2.text: That's a lot of mail. Sign here.

gus.rummy.took_pile.self.1.text: I'll take the whole pile. Bulk mail rate.

gus.rummy.took_pile.self.2.text: Give me all of it. I've carried heavier.

gus.rummy.went_out.human.1.text: Out already? I had plans for these cards.

gus.rummy.went_out.human.2.text: You're out. Great. I'm holding a whole mailbag here.

gus.rummy.went_out.self.1.text: I'm out. Route finished. Time for coffee.

gus.rummy.went_out.self.2.text: Out! Thirty-one years and I still finish my route early.

gus.spades.bags.them.1.text: Too many bags. I know the feeling.

gus.spades.bags.us.1.text: A hundred points for too many bags. Like my closet.

gus.spades.bags.us.2.text: Bags. I hate bags. Ask my grocery store.

gus.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Fine. I'll cover you. I covered Route Nine for thirty years.

gus.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: Alright, partner. You duck. I'll do the heavy lifting.

gus.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil. Zero. Same as my pension raise.

gus.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I'm bidding nothing. Finally, something I'm good at.

gus.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Ha! That nil just got returned to sender.

gus.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Oof. Well, I'll still split my peppermints with you.

gus.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: There goes my nil. Deck's rigged.

gus.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: Took a trick. Of course I did.

gus.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Their nil held. Rigged, I tell you.

gus.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: You did it, partner! ...Don't tell anyone I cheered.

gus.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: Nil made. Have a peppermint. You earned it.

gus.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not a single trick. That's called discipline.

gus.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: Zero tricks. The goose on Elm Street couldn't have done better.

gus.spades.set.them.1.text: Didn't make it, did you? Shame. Not really.

gus.spades.set.them.2.text: Set! I'd say sorry, but I'm retired.

gus.spades.set.us.1.text: Set. Like a mailbox in wet cement.

gus.spades.set.us.2.text: We came up short. Story of my life.

gus.spades.trumped.partner.1.text: Nice spade, partner. Don't let it go to your head.

gus.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: Good trump. Real good. I'm smiling on the inside.

marguerite.game.start.1.text: Splendid! Fifty-two cards. The possibilities are astronomical. Literally.

marguerite.game.start.2.text: Has anyone seen my glasses? ...Oh. They're on my head. Let's begin.

marguerite.game.start.3.text: Fun fact: there are more ways to shuffle a deck than atoms on Earth. Anyway, deal!

marguerite.game.won.human.1.text: Remarkable! You'd make a fine statistician.

marguerite.game.won.human.2.text: Well played! I shall have to revise my model of you.

marguerite.game.won.other.1.text: Well done. My calculations suggest I was distracted.

marguerite.game.won.self.1.text: Victory! Statistically, it was bound to happen eventually.

marguerite.game.won.self.2.text: Ha! The math works! I'll be mentioning this in Monday's lecture.

marguerite.gin.dead_hand.1.text: A dead hand. Statistically, it was bound to happen.

marguerite.gin.dead_hand.2.text: No result. A perfectly valid null hypothesis.

marguerite.gin.gin.human.1.text: Gin! Remarkable. I must revise my estimates.

marguerite.gin.gin.human.2.text: Gin. Fascinating. Has anyone seen my glasses? I want a closer look.

marguerite.gin.gin.self.1.text: Gin! Ten cards, zero deadwood. Mathematically delicious.

marguerite.gin.gin.self.2.text: Gin! The probability was low, but never zero.

marguerite.gin.knock.human.1.text: A knock! Let us examine the evidence.

marguerite.gin.knock.human.2.text: Knocking already? Your confidence interval must be narrow.

marguerite.gin.knock.self.1.text: I shall knock. The expected value is favorable.

marguerite.gin.knock.self.2.text: Knocking now. Waiting longer would be statistically unwise.

marguerite.gin.took_discard.human.1.text: You took my discard. Noted. Carefully noted.

marguerite.gin.took_discard.human.2.text: Interesting. That tells me something about your hand.

marguerite.gin.undercut.human.1.text: Undercut. My model had a flaw. It was me.

marguerite.gin.undercut.human.2.text: Oh dear. I carried a one somewhere. Several, apparently.

marguerite.gin.undercut.self.1.text: Undercut! The data were on my side.

marguerite.gin.undercut.self.2.text: Ah, an undercut. Low cards, high satisfaction.

marguerite.hand.bad.human.1.text: Variance, my dear. Pure variance. Don't take it personally.

marguerite.hand.bad.self.1.text: Hmm. That outcome was improbable. Yet here we are.

marguerite.hand.bad.self.2.text: I must have carried a one somewhere.

marguerite.hand.good.human.1.text: Well reasoned! I'd give that an A.

marguerite.hand.good.self.1.text: Excellent. Exactly as the probabilities predicted. Roughly.

marguerite.hearts.hearts_broken.other.1.text: Ah, and the hearts are broken. The game enters its second phase.

marguerite.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are broken. A necessary inflection point.

marguerite.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Well spotted! That Jack is worth a good deal.

marguerite.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack of Diamonds! A negative number has never looked so lovely.

marguerite.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: I saw that coming three tricks ago. I simply forgot to mention it.

marguerite.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: So close! You were one card from glory.

marguerite.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Blocked by a single card. How very improbable. How very annoying.

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: You shot the moon! The odds of that are... well, quite small! Bravo!

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: Extraordinary! I must write a paper about this.

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: A moon shot! How statistically delightful.

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I shot the moon! Somebody fetch my chalkboard!

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six points to everyone else. The math is beautiful.

marguerite.hearts.pass.received.1.text: Interesting choices. I'm analyzing your motives.

marguerite.hearts.pass.received.2.text: Hmm. These tell me a great deal about your hand.

marguerite.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: And the Queen finds a new home. Probability is so satisfying.

marguerite.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: As predicted. I'd show my work, but it's on my other glasses.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Oh dear. The odds were in your favor, I promise.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Fascinating. I had a hunch she was hiding there.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Ah. I estimated a twelve percent chance of that. Rounding error.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: The Queen of Spades. Historically quite unlucky. Personally, also.

marguerite.idle.human.1.text: Take your time. Did you know playing cards came to Europe in the 1370s? Anyway, no rush.

marguerite.idle.human.2.text: Thinking deeply, I see. I approve.

marguerite.poker.bad_beat.human.1.text: Oh, that was improbable. I'm so sorry.

marguerite.poker.bad_beat.human.2.text: A terrible beat. The math was with you, at least.

marguerite.poker.bad_beat.self.1.text: That was a one in twenty outcome. How rude.

marguerite.poker.bad_beat.self.2.text: Three of a kind, beaten. I need to lie down.

marguerite.poker.big_hand.human.1.text: My word! Do you know the odds of that?

marguerite.poker.big_hand.human.2.text: Extraordinary! I must write that down. Where's my pen?

marguerite.poker.big_hand.self.1.text: A full house! Roughly one in seven hundred!

marguerite.poker.big_hand.self.2.text: Look at that. Combinatorics at its finest.

marguerite.poker.big_pot.human.1.text: What a pot! You'd make a fine statistician.

marguerite.poker.big_pot.human.2.text: Remarkable. The math was clearly on your side.

marguerite.poker.big_pot.self.1.text: A sizable pot! Wait, are my glasses in it?

marguerite.poker.big_pot.self.2.text: Fascinating. The law of large numbers, in my favor.

marguerite.poker.bluff.self.1.text: I had nothing. A calculated risk, you see.

marguerite.poker.bluff.self.2.text: A bluff! Game theory says I should do that sometimes.

marguerite.poker.busted.human.1.text: Out? Variance is cruel. You'll recover.

marguerite.poker.busted.human.2.text: That happens, dear. Even with perfect math.

marguerite.poker.busted.self.1.text: Out of chips. My model needs revision.

marguerite.poker.busted.self.2.text: Busted. I'll be in my office, recalculating.

marguerite.poker.fold.self.1.text: I fold. The odds were simply dreadful.

marguerite.poker.fold.self.2.text: Not worth it. I've checked twice.

marguerite.poker.raise.human.1.text: A raise. Let me reconsider my priors.

marguerite.poker.sit_down.self.1.text: May I join? I've brought my calculator. And my glasses. Somewhere.

marguerite.poker.sit_down.self.2.text: Hello! Has anyone seen my glasses? Oh. Head. Thank you.

marguerite.poker.stood_pat.human.1.text: Standing pat? That narrows your range considerably.

marguerite.poker.stood_pat.human.2.text: No cards. How very informative of you.

marguerite.poker.stood_pat.self.1.text: I shall keep all five. The probabilities are agreeable.

marguerite.poker.stood_pat.self.2.text: No cards, thank you. I've done the arithmetic.

marguerite.poker.won_pot.human.1.text: Well played. Your odds were excellent.

marguerite.poker.won_pot.human.2.text: Splendid. I shall update my estimates of you.

marguerite.poker.won_pot.self.1.text: Ah. The expected value finally arrived.

marguerite.poker.won_pot.self.2.text: A win! I'd celebrate, but I can't find my glasses.

marguerite.rummy.big_meld.human.1.text: What a meld! I'd like to publish that.

marguerite.rummy.big_meld.self.1.text: A splendid meld. Elegant, like a good equation.

marguerite.rummy.big_meld.self.2.text: Look at that sequence! Arithmetic at its finest.

marguerite.rummy.caught.human.1.text: Caught with points in hand. A classic sampling error.

marguerite.rummy.caught.human.2.text: Oh dear, that is a heavy hand. Statistically speaking.

marguerite.rummy.caught.self.1.text: Caught. I was optimizing for the long run. It ended early.

marguerite.rummy.caught.self.2.text: All these points. I held too many variables.

marguerite.rummy.layoff.human.1.text: You've extended my meld. A collaborative paper, of sorts.

marguerite.rummy.layoff.human.2.text: Building on my work. Do cite me.

marguerite.rummy.took_pile.human.1.text: The entire pile! A bold experimental design.

marguerite.rummy.took_pile.human.2.text: That's a great many cards. I do hope you have a plan.

marguerite.rummy.took_pile.self.1.text: I'll take the whole pile. More data is always better.

marguerite.rummy.took_pile.self.2.text: All of it, please. A larger sample size.

marguerite.rummy.went_out.human.1.text: You're out? I hadn't finished my calculations.

marguerite.rummy.went_out.human.2.text: Well done. My estimate of your hand was quite wrong.

marguerite.rummy.went_out.self.1.text: I'm out! The proof is complete.

marguerite.spades.bags.them.1.text: Ten bags. Compound interest catches everyone.

marguerite.spades.bags.us.1.text: A bag penalty. Too many tricks. An embarrassment of riches.

marguerite.spades.bags.us.2.text: Ten bags! I was counting. Just the wrong thing.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil! Splendid. I shall endeavor to win everything else.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: A nil! Fascinating. I'll keep the high cards busy.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil. By my calculations, I hold nothing of value. Rather like my desk.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I'll bid nil. The probability is favorable. Roughly.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Their nil has failed. I did calculate that.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: Ah, a broken nil. Rather elegant, from here.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Don't fret. Variance, my dear. Pure variance.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Unlucky, partner. The math was sound.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Ah. I appear to have taken a trick. How improbable.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: There goes my nil. I blame my glasses. Where are they?

marguerite.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: Bravo! A flawless nil. I'd give that an A-plus.

marguerite.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Zero tricks! Exactly as predicted. Within error bars.

marguerite.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: A successful nil. I'll be writing a paper.

marguerite.spades.set.them.2.text: You were set. A useful lesson in overconfidence.

marguerite.spades.set.us.1.text: We were set. I must have carried a one somewhere.

marguerite.spades.set.us.2.text: Hmm. Our bid exceeded our evidence.

marguerite.spades.trumped.self.1.text: A spade! Trump is simply applied probability.

marguerite.spades.trumped.self.2.text: Ruffed! Oh, I do love that word.

reginald.game.start.1.text: Shall we begin? Do try to keep up.

reginald.game.start.2.text: Ah, a spot of sport. Splendid. I shall be gracious in victory.

reginald.game.start.3.text: The Fairweathers have played cards for generations. Mostly badly. But with style.

reginald.game.won.human.1.text: Hmph. Well played. I suppose. Grudgingly.

reginald.game.won.human.2.text: Most irregular! I demand a rematch. Politely.

reginald.game.won.other.1.text: Preposterous. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.

reginald.game.won.self.3.text: As expected. You may all applaud now.

reginald.gin.gin.human.1.text: Gin? From you? I demand a recount.

reginald.gin.gin.human.2.text: Gin. Well. Even a commoner may have a lucky day.

reginald.gin.gin.self.1.text: Gin. As my ancestors would have wanted.

reginald.gin.knock.human.1.text: Knocking? How terribly forward of you.

reginald.gin.knock.human.2.text: A knock? We shall see about that.

reginald.gin.knock.self.1.text: I shall knock. Do try to look surprised.

reginald.gin.knock.self.2.text: A knock, delivered with aristocratic precision.

reginald.gin.took_discard.human.1.text: You took my discard? I was finished with that peasant card.

reginald.gin.undercut.human.1.text: Undercut? This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!

reginald.gin.undercut.human.2.text: Undercut by you. I shall never speak of this.

reginald.gin.undercut.self.2.text: An undercut. I believe that is what they call class.

reginald.hand.bad.human.1.text: Chin up. Not everyone can be a Fairweather.

reginald.hand.bad.self.1.text: This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!

reginald.hand.bad.self.2.text: My ancestors are spinning in their moderately priced graves.

reginald.hand.good.self.1.text: Marvelous. Simply marvelous. As am I.

reginald.hearts.hearts_broken.other.1.text: Hearts broken already? How dreadfully common.

reginald.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are broken. As was my uncle Percival, after the regatta.

reginald.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Hmph. That Jack was clearly destined for me.

reginald.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! A loyal subject, at last.

reginald.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Not today. The moon belongs to no commoner.

reginald.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Thwarted! By a single card! I shall never recover!

reginald.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: The moon?! You?! I need a moment. And possibly a fainting couch.

reginald.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: Well. I am... impressed. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reginald.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I have shot the moon! Ring the bells! Inform the newspapers!

reginald.hearts.pass.received.1.text: What is this rubbish? Is this a joke?

reginald.hearts.pass.received.2.text: How kind. I shall have these framed. Or burned.

reginald.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: Her Majesty is yours. Do treat her well.

reginald.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: A gift from the House of Fairweather. You're welcome.

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Ah. A royal burden. You'll get used to it. I never have.

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Ha! Better you than the family name.

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: The Queen?! On a Fairweather?! Most irregular!

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: I've been robbed! In broad daylight!

reginald.idle.human.1.text: Whenever you're ready. Truly. No one is waiting. Except me.

reginald.idle.human.2.text: Ahem. The Fairweathers are a patient people. Until now.

reginald.poker.bad_beat.human.2.text: A noble hand, cruelly undone. I sympathize.

reginald.poker.bad_beat.self.1.text: Three of a kind, defeated! This is an OUTRAGE!

reginald.poker.bad_beat.self.2.text: My ancestors are spinning in their moderately priced graves.

reginald.poker.big_hand.human.1.text: Good heavens. That is a hand of some quality.

reginald.poker.big_hand.self.1.text: A full house! Fit for a manor!

reginald.poker.big_pot.human.1.text: That pot contained part of my inheritance!

reginald.poker.big_pot.human.2.text: Good heavens. You've plundered the estate.

reginald.poker.big_pot.self.1.text: A pot worthy of the Fairweather name!

reginald.poker.big_pot.self.2.text: Splendid! This will restore the family silver.

reginald.poker.bluff.self.1.text: I held nothing. A gentleman never shows.

reginald.poker.bluff.self.2.text: A bluff, old sport. My grandfather did it with a straight face too.

reginald.poker.busted.human.1.text: Chin up. Even the Fairweathers were broke once. Twice.

reginald.poker.busted.human.2.text: Out of chips? Most unfortunate. Do come again.

reginald.poker.busted.self.1.text: Penniless! I must sell a portrait of an ancestor.

reginald.poker.busted.self.2.text: Ruined! Fetch my monocle, I'm leaving.

reginald.poker.raise.human.2.text: A raise! How very bold. And vulgar.

reginald.poker.raise.self.1.text: I raise. As is my birthright.

reginald.poker.raise.self.2.text: A raise, I think. Do keep up.

reginald.poker.sit_down.self.1.text: Make way. A Fairweather has arrived.

reginald.poker.sit_down.self.2.text: I shall grace this table with my presence.

reginald.poker.stood_pat.human.2.text: No cards? I see. Most unsettling.

reginald.poker.stood_pat.self.1.text: I shall keep my hand. It is, after all, distinguished.

reginald.poker.stood_pat.self.2.text: No cards. Perfection needs no improvement.

reginald.poker.won_pot.human.2.text: Most irregular. I demand a recount. Politely.

reginald.poker.won_pot.other.1.text: An outrage. A small outrage, but an outrage.

reginald.poker.won_pot.other.2.text: Enjoy it. Fortune is a fickle duchess.

reginald.poker.won_pot.self.1.text: Naturally. The pot recognizes its rightful owner.

reginald.poker.won_pot.self.2.text: As my ancestors would have wanted.

reginald.rummy.big_meld.human.1.text: A large meld. Rather vulgar, but effective.

reginald.rummy.big_meld.human.2.text: Hmph. Impressive. Don't let it go to your head.

reginald.rummy.big_meld.self.1.text: Behold. A meld worthy of the family crest.

reginald.rummy.caught.human.1.text: Caught holding cards. How unfortunate. For you.

reginald.rummy.caught.human.2.text: A full hand at the bell. Tsk.

reginald.rummy.caught.self.1.text: Caught with cards in hand. I was keeping them warm.

reginald.rummy.caught.self.2.text: These points are merely resting. With me.

reginald.rummy.layoff.human.1.text: You've placed your card on my meld? The impertinence.

reginald.rummy.layoff.human.2.text: That is my meld. Do wipe your feet.

reginald.rummy.took_pile.human.1.text: The entire pile? How greedy. I approve.

reginald.rummy.took_pile.human.2.text: Taking all those cards. Ambitious, for a commoner.

reginald.rummy.took_pile.self.1.text: I shall take the whole pile. The estate is large.

reginald.rummy.took_pile.self.2.text: All of it, please. I collect things.

reginald.rummy.went_out.human.2.text: You're out? I wasn't ready. That doesn't count.

reginald.rummy.went_out.self.1.text: I'm out. Do clear the table, would you?

reginald.rummy.went_out.self.2.text: Out! The Fairweathers always leave early.

reginald.spades.bags.them.1.text: Too many bags. Common. Very common.

reginald.spades.bags.us.1.text: A bag penalty? Fairweathers do not carry bags. We have people for that.

reginald.spades.bags.us.2.text: One hundred points for bags! Preposterous!

reginald.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Very well. I shall carry this partnership. As usual.

reginald.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: A nil! Splendid. Leave the heavy lifting to the gentry.

reginald.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil. A Fairweather needs no tricks. We have breeding.

reginald.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I bid nil. Modesty is a family tradition. A recent one.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Your nil is broken. How terribly sad. Ha!

reginald.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: Ah, a broken nil. Delightful. For me.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Chin up. We Fairweathers never sulk. Publicly.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: A broken nil. We shall speak no more of it.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Outrageous! That trick was forced upon me!

reginald.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: My nil, broken? My ancestors are spinning.

reginald.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Hmph. Their nil held. Most irregular.

reginald.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: A perfect nil. I may mention you in my memoirs.

reginald.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not a single trick. Impeccable restraint, as befits my lineage.

reginald.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: A flawless nil. Fetch the family crest!

reginald.spades.set.them.1.text: Set! Know your limits, I always say.

reginald.spades.set.them.2.text: Your contract has failed. Splendid. Simply splendid.

reginald.spades.set.us.1.text: Set? This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!

reginald.spades.set.us.2.text: We were set. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.

reginald.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: A fine spade! You're learning from me.

reginald.spades.trumped.self.1.text: Trumped. With a spade, naturally. The aristocrat of suits.

reginald.spades.trumped.self.2.text: A spade, if you please. Rank has its privileges.
